content_sections.heading: DH&FWS Purba Bardhaman ANM (Community Health Assistant-Urban) Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The recruitment encompasses a total of 118 vacancies distributed across various health positions under different health programs in Purba Bardhaman district.

content_sections.heading: DH&FWS Purba Bardhaman ANM (Community Health Assistant-Urban) Eligibility Criteria 2026

rows.qualification_required: Passed ANM course from an Institute recognized by Indian Nursing Council and registered with West Bengal Nursing Council OR passed GNM course. Proficient in Bengali and permanent resident of Purba Bardhaman. Female only.
Graduate in science with minimum 1-year experience working as MPW/LHV/ANM/Health Worker and certificate course in computer operations (minimum 2 months). Preferential: Training course for MPW.

Graduate in science subject, well conversant with computer programming including MS Word and Excel, and permanent two-wheeler driving license with ability to drive. Preferential: MSW and at least 1 year experience in National Health Programme.

Graduate with DMLT or BMLT from a recognized institution, permanent two-wheeler driving license with ability to drive, and well conversant with computer programming including MS Word and Excel. Preferential: Minimum 1 year experience in National Health Programme.

Two years Diploma in Pharmacy (D-Pharm) (Allopathic) recognized by Government of West Bengal and registered as "A" category pharmacist under West Bengal Pharmacy Council. Proficiency in Bengali and computers.

Completed GNM training course from an institute recognized by Indian Nursing/WB Nursing Council OR B.Sc. Nursing. Must be registered under WB Nursing Council and proficient in local language. Female only.
Bachelor degree in Physiotherapy with at least 2 years of working experience in a hospital. Desirable: Master degree in Physiotherapy.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies in DH&FWS Purba Bardhaman Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 118 vacancies advertised across various health posts including ANM, Staff Nurse, Pharmacist, STS, STLS, TBHV, and Multi Rehabilitation Worker.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for DH&FWS Purba Bardhaman Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of applications is 13 November 2026 up to 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for general candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 100/- for general candidates and Rs. 50/- for reserved categories, payable via NEFT or online payment.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for ANM posts in Purba Bardhaman recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit for ANM posts is a minimum of 21 years and a maximum of 40 years as on 1st January 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for Staff Nurse -NUHM?
faq.answer: Candidates must have completed a GNM training course from an institute recognized by the Indian Nursing Council or West Bengal Nursing Council (or B.Sc. Nursing), be registered under WB Nursing Council, and be permanent residents of West Bengal.

faq.question: Q6. Is this recruitment permanent or contractual?
faq.answer: These posts are purely contractual in nature with an initial period of engagement up to March 2027, which may be renewed based on satisfactory performance and approval of higher authority.

faq.question: Q7. Who gets age relaxations in this recruitment?
faq.answer: Age relaxation is given for reserved candidates as per existing norms of the State Government.

faq.question: Q8. What are the desirable qualifications for Multi Rehabilitation Worker?
faq.answer: The desirable qualification is a Master degree in Physiotherapy, while the essential qualification is a Bachelor degree in Physiotherapy with at least 2 years of working experience in a hospital.

faq.question: Q9. Which documents need to be submitted with the application?
faq.answer: Required documents include photo proof identity card, proof of permanent residential status attested by a Gazetted Officer or Group "A" Officer, age proof certificate, caste category certificate if applicable, marksheets and certificates of academic and professional examinations, and registration certificates.
